name: Thermals
author: Forsythe McSquiddington
description: Thermals — system temperatures in the Omarchy bar: CPU, GPU, drives, RAM and fans straight from hwmon, with a panel listing every probe.

barWidget.description: A thermometer with one temperature beside it in the bar, and a panel with every temperature and fan the kernel exposes, grouped by what they measure.

schema.label: Temperature shown in the bar
schema.description: Which reading sits beside the thermometer. Falls back to the hottest probe when the chosen kind is not present.

schema.label: Show the temperature next to the icon
schema.description: Off leaves just the thermometer, which still changes colour when something runs hot.

schema.label: List every probe
schema.description: Adds per-core, per-drive-sensor and ACPI zone readings that normally duplicate a better-labelled row.

schema.label: Warm threshold (°C, 0 = per sensor)
schema.description: Overrides every sensor's own warm threshold. Leave at 0 to use what the driver reports, or a sensible default per kind when it reports nothing.

schema.label: Hot threshold (°C, 0 = per sensor)
schema.description: Overrides every sensor's own hot threshold; the bar icon turns urgent past it.
